entries.title: Phaguna and a little cold
entries.literal_meaning: Source-based provisional rendering: in Phaguna, the cold becomes slight.
entries.explanation: The rhyme sits directly under the dictionary’s adjective meaning “slight.” A later sense means “double,” but substituting it would reverse this reading. Our reading keeps the smallness suggested by the local gloss and hears a brief seasonal observation. It does not turn the line into a forecast for every place or year.
entries.meaning_odia: ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଅଳ୍ପ ପରିମିତ ବା ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ପରର ଅର୍ଥ ଦ୍ୱିଗୁଣ; ତାହା ଏଠି ବସାଇଲେ ପାଠ ଓଲଟିଯିବ। ଆମ ପାଠ ନିକଟର ଅର୍ଥକୁ ଧରି ଅଳ୍ପ ଶୀତର ଏକ ଋତୁସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ କଥା ଶୁଣେ। ଉତ୍ସର ଦୁଗ୍ଣ ଶବ୍ଦରୂପ ରଖି ଏହାକୁ ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ପାଠ କୁହାଯାଉଛି। ସବୁ ସ୍ଥାନ ବା ବର୍ଷର ପାଣିପାଗ ଏଥିରୁ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ହୁଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: The adjacent source gloss guides a cautious reading of the seasonal rhyme.
entries.odia_summary: ଋତୁର ଧାଡ଼ି ପଢ଼ିବାରେ ପାଖର ଉତ୍ସାର୍ଥ ସତର୍କ ପଥ ଦେଖାଏ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଦୁଇଜଣ ପରପର ଥିବା ଭିନ୍ନ ଅର୍ଥ ଦେଖିଲେ। ଜଣେ କହିଲେ, ପରିଚିତ ଅର୍ଥକୁ ଆଗେ ବସାଇଦେବା ଠିକ୍ ହେବନାହିଁ। / Readers check where a quotation sits before choosing a familiar meaning. This discussion is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Exact ଦୁଗ୍ଣ is not silently normalized to the headword. No modern calendar conversion, meteorological measurement, regional origin or universal seasonal rule is established.

entries.title: The roof before the first step
entries.literal_meaning: Before setting foot in the house, the roof strikes the head.
entries.explanation: The obstacle arrives before entry has even been completed. The dictionary gives beginning a task as the figurative sense of stepping into a house. Our reading follows that timing: a difficulty meets an undertaking at its start. The line does not identify a particular failure, blame someone for it, or say whether the work will eventually succeed.
entries.meaning_odia: ଘରେ ପାଦ ରଖିବା ଆଗରୁ ହିଁ ବାଧା ଆସିଯାଏ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଘରେ ଗୋଡ଼ ଦେବାର ଲକ୍ଷଣାର୍ଥ କୌଣସି କାମ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା। ଆମ ପାଠ ଏହି ସମୟକୁ ଧରେ: କାମ ଆରମ୍ଭରେ ଅସୁବିଧା ସାମ୍ନାକୁ ଆସୁଛି। ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ବିଫଳତା ଚିହ୍ନାଏନାହିଁ, କାହାକୁ ଦୋଷ ଦିଏନାହିଁ, କିମ୍ବା ଶେଷରେ କାମ ସଫଳ ହେବ କି ନାହିଁ କହେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading notices trouble at the beginning, without deciding the ending.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଆରମ୍ଭର ବାଧା ଦେଖେ, ଶେଷ ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପଢ଼ାଘର ଖୋଲିବାକୁ ଯାଇ ଦଳଟି ତାଲିକାରେ ଭୁଲ ଦେଖିଲା। ସେମାନେ କାମ ଛାଡ଼ିଦେବା ବଦଳରେ ତାଲିକାଟି ସୁଧାରିଲେ। / A group finds and corrects an error before opening a reading room. This outcome is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Sense2 supplies the task-beginning connection. The roof image does not document an actual injury, construction defect or historical event; its application here is editorial.
